    boy_patches = image_patch.find("boy")
    black_patches = image_patch.find("black")

    intersections = [center for center in boy_centers if center in black_centers]
    if not intersections: return boy_patches[0]
    closest_index = intersections[0]
    closest_distance = abs(intersections[0] - boy_centers[0])

            if distance < closest_distance:
                closest_distance = distance
                closest_index = index
    return boy_patches[boy_centers.index(intersections[closest_index])]
